scope: Thorough retry of the three remaining capitals in the 50 states plus Washington, D.C. cohort.

cities.sourceNotice: Identified Franklin County PVA map parcel groups; mixed record years, current boundary date unestablished
caveats: PARCEL_ID alone conflicts with native parcel components; the reversible compound identity retains both published identifiers without inventing a replacement cadastral number.
Nonblank PARCEL_ID and PARCEL required. Same-key parts must not overlap and must agree on MAP; conflicting groups fail visibly.
Mixed v_SY values are not a proven lifecycle filter or current-boundary date. No source-type or arbitrary latest-year filter is applied.

cities.sourceNotice: Oklahoma County assessment parcels; other Oklahoma City counties excluded
caveats: Native accountno is an assessment-account identity. Complete disjoint components must agree on pin and propertyid; overlapping or inconsistent groups fail visibly.
632 county rows lack accountno and are excluded from identified-account scope.
Layer dataLastEditDate observed 2026-09-26 is a service-edit timestamp, not the date of every legal boundary.

cities.sourceNotice: ISG third-party parcel mirror · 2023 snapshot · identified parcels only
caveats: Third-party planning-project mirror labelled 2023; layer XML records February 9, 2023 creation/synchronization. ArcGIS publication in February 2026 does not make the parcel boundaries current.

The upstream supplier is not identified in publisher metadata. Native numbering agrees with the county Beacon record convention after leading-zero formatting; provenance beyond the ISG project is not asserted.
Blank and zero parcel keys are excluded. The 674 zero-key rows share a blank RECORD_ value and cannot identify individual parcels; zero as an unassigned placeholder is an inference.
All parts of a native PARCEL_ID must agree on RECORD_ and have no material overlap; ambiguous groups fail visibly.

invariants: Coverage is source-specific and does not imply complete current city, county or state cadastres.
No parcel geometries or owner attributes imported into the app database or retained in this research directory.
Terms are informational; no source was held on reuse restrictions.
Historical failed probes remain intact, including now-resolved identity failures and still-blocked original endpoints.
